title: [Audit] 🔎 Elasticsearch Data Access
description: What data was read, by whom, through which transport action — including system indices.

config.description: All Elasticsearch audit events in range.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | STATS `Elasticsearch events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Distinct indices named in audited requests, with each data stream's backing indices and each run of dated daily indices counted once. Wildcard and date-math expressions (*, -*, <…{now/d}>) are patterns, not indices, and are left out.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | STATS BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS `Index families` = COUNT_DISTINCT(family)

config.description: Distinct Elasticsearch transport actions (cluster:*, indices:*), shard-level variants included.
ES|QL queries submitted — one per query, not per shard or sub-step. Includes the queries these dashboards run to draw themselves.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/esql" | STATS `ES|QL queries` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Requests touching dot-prefixed system and hidden indices (.kibana*, .security*, .slo-*, .alerts-*), counted once per index named. Backing indices of ordinary data streams (.ds-logs-…) are not system data and are left out, as are shard-level copies of a request.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS `System index access` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Authorization denials. Sustained non-zero values mean a misconfigured client or a probe.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "access_denied" OR attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Access denied` = COUNT(*)

config.title: Data access over time by action family
config.description: Elasticsearch audit volume over time by kind of transport action, after the noise gate and with shard-level and ES|QL sub-step fan-out removed, so each request counts once. "other" is mostly authentication events that carry no transport action.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY time = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") | EVAL family = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read*", "read", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/write*", "write", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin*", "index admin", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin/xpack/security*", "security admin", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:admin*", "cluster admin", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*:monitor*", "monitor", "other") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY time, family

config.title: Who reads which index family
config.description: The 10 busiest identities across the top, and the 25 index families they read most down the side; a more solid cell is more requests, on a log scale. A data stream and its backing indices are one family, as is a run of dated daily indices; wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. A blank cell means that identity did not touch that family in range — or touched it too little to be among the 500 busiest identity/family pairs. A request naming several indices counts once per index.

config.title: Most-accessed index families
config.description: Which indices see the most audited access, and how many distinct identities touch each. A data stream and its backing indices are one row, as is a run of dated daily indices; `Indices` says how many real indices the row folds together. Wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. A request naming several indices counts once per index.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), index = REPLACE(REPLACE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor) BY index | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 14

config.title: Transport actions
config.description: Elasticsearch transport actions with their request class, after the noise gate removes health pings, search-phase internals and connection and bulk-authentication events. Shard-level copies and the ES|QL engine's sub-steps are folded away, so a query counts once as indices:data/read/esql — including the queries these dashboards run.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, request = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.request.name | WHERE NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql/*") | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Denied requests
config.description: Who was refused, what they asked for and on which index — newest first. This is the failure slice the old outcome donut drew as a hairline. Index "—" is a cluster-level request; <anonymous> with action "—" is an HTTP call that carried no credentials. A request naming several indices shows once per index. Empty means nothing was denied in range.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "access_denied" OR attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, index = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), index = COALESCE(index, "—"), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action = COALESCE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, "—") | KEEP actor, index, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, events, last_seen | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: ⚠️ System and hidden index access
config.description: Who touched system and hidden indices — Kibana internals, the security index, alerting and SLO data — one row per identity, index group (.alerts*, .slo*, .kibana*…) and action. `Indices` says how many real indices the row covers; the Discover session below names each one. Sorted by most recent, not by volume: sorting by volume buries a one-off read under routine polling. Backing indices of ordinary data streams (.ds-logs-…) and shard-level copies of a request are left out. Expected from Kibana and platform automation; unexpected from anyone else.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, action = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), area = CONCAT(REPLACE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.[^-._]+).*$""", "$1"), "*") | STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices), last_seen = MAX(seen) BY actor, area, action | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 13

config.title: System index access
config.description: The newest 1,000 requests against a system or hidden index, one row per index named, newest first. It stops at 1,000, so it can hold fewer rows than the System index access tile counts.
